name: Metal Scorpion - Deadly Statue
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SIMULTANEOUS STRIKE When Jafar plays this
character, each Illumineer chooses and banishes
one of their characters, one of their items, and one
of their locations.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
同時打擊　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，每位光耀者選擇並消滅他們的一個角色、一個物品和一個地點。

name: Palace Guard - Crown Hunter
en:
BRING IT TO ME When Jafar plays this character,
he steals The Reforged Crown.
zh: 把它拿來給我　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，他偷取 The Reforged Crown。

name: Iago - Raucous Lookout
en:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one
of Jafar's characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
JAFAR'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
SOUND THE ALARM While this character is exerted,
Jafar's locations can't be challenged.
zh:
護衛（挑戰 Jafar 角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
Jafar 的哨兵　這個角色以橫置狀態進場。
拉響警報　當這個角色橫置時，Jafar 的地點不能被挑戰。

name: Razoul - Unyielding Guard
en:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges
one of Jafar's characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
JAFAR'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
zh:
護衛（挑戰 Jafar 角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
Jafar 的哨兵　這個角色以橫置狀態進場。

name: Treasure Guardian - Illusionary Protector
en:
SHIFTING SANDS Illumineers can't use
battleground abilities.
zh: 流動的沙　光耀者不能使用戰場能力。

name: Jafar - Spectral Sorcerer
en:
RETURN TO ME! When Jafar plays this character,
he plays all items named Mechanical Snake from
his discard for free.
zh: 回到我身邊！　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，他免費從棄牌堆打出所有名為 Mechanical Snake 的物品。

name: Genie - Towering Phantasm
zh: 完美時機　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，若每位光耀者在場都有橫置的角色，他獲得 3 點傳說值。

name: The Sultan - Spectral Ruler
en:
PAY FEALTY When Jafar plays this character, each
Illumineer chooses and discards a card.
zh: 效忠　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，每位光耀者選擇並棄掉一張牌。

name: Jasmine - Ephemeral Princess
en:
OVER HERE! Whenever this character quests, Jafar
draws a card.
zh: 在這邊！　每當這個角色探險時，Jafar 抽一張牌。

name: Gazeem - Ruthless Ruffian
en:
FIGHTING DIRTY When Jafar plays this character, he
deals 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.
zh: 卑鄙手段　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，他對每個受傷的對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Iago - Crown Seeker
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOTCHA! Whenever this character quests, Jafar
steals The Reforged Crown.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
逮到你了！　每當這個角色探險時，Jafar 偷取 The Reforged Crown。

name: Monumental Scarab - Skittering Statue
en:
SECRET VULNERABILITY During the Illumineers'
turn, they may pay 3 ⬡ each to banish this
character.
zh: 秘密弱點　在光耀者的回合中，他們可以各支付 3 ⬡ 來消滅這個角色。

name: Gargantuan Cobra - Slithering Statue
en:
SERPENT'S SHADOW When Jafar plays this
character, he deals 3 damage to each opposing
exerted character.
zh: 巨蛇之影　當 Jafar 打出這個角色時，他對每個橫置的對方角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Tiger Behemoth - Hulking Statue
en:
DREADFUL STARE This character can't be
challenged by damaged characters.
zh: 駭人凝視　這個角色不能被受傷的角色挑戰。

name: Aladdin - Misleading Phantom
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Sandblast
en:
Jafar deals 1 damage to each opposing character.
Then, put this card into his inkwell facedown.
zh: Jafar 對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。然後，將這張牌牌面朝下放入他的墨水池。

name: Destructive Misstep
en:
Jafar's locations lose Ward until the start of his next turn.
The Illumineers may choose and banish up to one of
Jafar's locations.
zh: Jafar 的地點失去守護，直到他的下個回合開始。光耀者可以選擇並消滅至多一個 Jafar 的地點。

name: Disastrous Sandstorm
en:
Each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their
items or locations.
zh: 每位光耀者選擇並消滅他們的一個物品或地點。

name: Sudden Power
en:
Jafar gains 2 lore. Then, put this card into his inkwell
facedown.
zh: Jafar 獲得 2 點傳說值。然後，將這張牌牌面朝下放入他的墨水池。

name: Arcane Quake
en:
Jafar exerts all opposing characters. They can't ready at
the start of their next turn.
zh: Jafar 橫置所有對方角色。他們在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Cataclysmic Cyclone
en:
Each Illumineer chooses one of their characters, items,
or locations. Then, Jafar banishes all other opposing
characters, items, and locations.
zh: 每位光耀者選擇他們的一個角色、物品或地點。然後，Jafar 消滅所有其他對方角色、物品和地點。

name: Sand Wave
en:
Jafar returns all opposing exerted characters to their
Illumineers' hands.
zh: Jafar 將所有橫置的對方角色返回其光耀者的手牌。

name: Mechanical Snake
en:
SEIZE THE CROWN! When Jafar plays this item, he steals
The Reforged Crown.
DISASSEMBLED SERPENT ⟳, Banish this item — Jafar gains
2 lore.
zh:
奪取王冠！　當 Jafar 打出這個物品時，他偷取 The Reforged Crown。
拆解的巨蛇　⟳，消滅這個物品 — Jafar 獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Fiery Basin
en:
FACE THE FLAMES At the start of Jafar's turn, he banishes
this item to have each Illumineer choose one of their
characters and deal 4 damage to them.
zh: 面對烈焰　在 Jafar 的回合開始時，他消滅這個物品，讓每位光耀者選擇他們的一個角色並對其造成 4 點傷害。

name: Giant Hourglass
en:
RISING SAND ⟳ — Jafar deals 1 damage to each
opposing character.
zh: 湧升之沙　⟳ — Jafar 對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Cobra Pit - Seething Serpents
en:
SNAKEBITE When Jafar plays this location, he deals 1 damage to each
opposing character.
zh: 蛇咬　當 Jafar 打出這個地點時，他對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Endless Staircase - Perilous Ascent
en:
VERTIGO When Jafar plays this location, he deals 3 damage to the
character with the highest cost each Illumineer has in play. (If there's a
tie, the Illumineers choose from the tied characters.)
zh: 眩暈　當 Jafar 打出這個地點時，他對每位光耀者在場費用最高的角色造成 3 點傷害。（若有平手，由光耀者從平手的角色中選擇。）

name: Royal Armory - Heavily Guarded
en: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this location is reduced by 1.)
zh: 抵抗 +1（這個地點受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Crystal Gate - Unbreakable Boundary
en: Ward (Illumineers can't choose this location except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（光耀者除了挑戰外不能選擇這個地點。）

name: Deepwell Labyrinth - Mystifying Halls
en:
MAP THE MAZE Whenever a character challenges this location, each
Illumineer chooses and discards a card.
zh: 繪製迷宮　每當有角色挑戰這個地點時，每位光耀者選擇並棄掉一張牌。

name: Hall of Illusions - Mysterious Chamber
en: WONDERSTRUCK Opposing characters can't quest.
zh: 驚奇不已　對方角色不能探險。

name: Clockwork Sawblades - Treacherous Trap
en:
Ward (Illumineers can't choose this location except to challenge.)
NO ESCAPE When Jafar plays this location, he deals 2 damage to each
opposing character.
zh:
守護（光耀者除了挑戰外不能選擇這個地點。）
無處可逃　當 Jafar 打出這個地點時，他對每個對方角色造成 2 點傷害。
